stories.headline: Andreas Almgren wins the New York City Marathon
stories.summary: The 2026 New York City Marathon was the 55th edition of the race and was run on Sunday 1 November. Around 60,000 runners started. Andreas Almgren won the men's division in his marathon debut, and became the first Swede to win the race in any division.

stories.headline: Tampa Bay win without completing a single pass
stories.summary: Heavy rain in Tampa made for difficult conditions, and Baker Mayfield made only three pass attempts and completed none of them. The Buccaneers still beat the Atlanta Falcons 16-0, the first National Football League team to win a game without completing a pass since the Buffalo Bills in 1974. Bucky Irving and Kenneth Gainwell both rushed for over 100 yards as Tampa Bay put up a franchise record 324 yards on the ground.

stories.headline: First generic approved for a twice-yearly HIV injection
stories.summary: The United States Food and Drug Administration has approved the first generic version of lenacapavir, a twice-yearly injection that prevents HIV. The generic is expected to cost about US$40 annually in 120 low- and middle-income countries.

stories.headline: The first fossil ape found in North Africa
stories.summary: A fossil ape recovered from Wadi Moghra in northern Egypt has been named Masripithecus moghraensis. It lived approximately 17 to 18 million years ago, during the Early Miocene, and is the first definitive fossil ape ever discovered in North Africa. The remains consist only of lower jaw material.
